# Rotten Tomatoes Editorial

> Rotten Tomatoes Editorial delivers curated movie rankings, box office analysis, awards coverage, and celebrity interviews powered by the Tomatometer scoring system.

The editorial hub provides comprehensive entertainment journalism including film guides, streaming recommendations, critical analysis, and breaking news about theatrical releases and industry events. It serves as a central resource for movie discovery and entertainment industry coverage.

## Key Topics

- Tomatometer
- Movie rankings
- Box office analysis
- Awards coverage
- Film recommendations
- Streaming guides
- Video interviews
- Entertainment news
- Oscar coverage
- Film criticism
- Theatrical releases
- Celebrity interviews
- Rotten Tomatoes App
- Weekend box office
- Period pieces

## Core Hubs

- [Rotten Tomatoes Homepage](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com): Homepage featuring movie rankings, news, interviews, and streaming guides
- [News](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/news): News hub featuring entertainment updates, film guides, and celebrity interviews
- [Countdown](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/countdown): Hub for ranked lists, movie rankings, and editorial countdown collections
- [Weekend Box Office](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/weekend-box-office): Hub for weekend box office analysis, rankings, and theatrical releases
- [Trophy Talk](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/trophy-talk): Awards coverage hub featuring predictions, nominees, and industry interviews
- [Video Interviews](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/video-interviews): Hub for video interviews with actors, directors, and critical analysis

## Movie Rankings & Guides

- [All Ryan Gosling Movies Ranked](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/guide/all-ryan-gosling-movies-ranked): Definitive ranking of Ryan Gosling's filmography by Tomatometer score
- [The 150 Best Sequels of All Time, Ranked by Tomatometer](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/guide/best-sequels-of-all-time): Comprehensive ranking of top 150 sequels by Tomatometer score
- [Best New Horror Movies of 2026](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/guide/best-new-horror-movies-2026): Curated guide to new horror movies in 2026 with reviews and recommendations

## Awards & Oscars Coverage

- [Best Moments From the 2026 Oscars](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/best-moments-from-the-2026-oscars): Highlights from 2026 Oscar ceremony including wins and memorable moments
- [Oscars 2026: Where to Watch the Winners and Nominees](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/where-to-watch-the-2026-oscar-winners): Streaming guide for 2026 Oscar winners and nominees
- [Park Chan-wook on Taking 20 Years to Make No Other Choice and Reuniting with Lee Byung-hun](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/park-chan-wook-no-other-choice-awards-tour-podcast): Awards tour podcast interview with director Park Chan-wook on No Other Choice

## Box Office Reports

- [Weekend Box Office: Scream 7 Scores Franchise-Best Opening](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/weekend-box-office-scream-7-scores-franchise-best-opening): Box office report on Scream 7's franchise-record $64.1M opening
- [Weekend Box Office: Hoppers Leaps to $46 Million Debut](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/weekend-box-office-hoppers-leaps-to-46-million-debut): Box office analysis of Hoppers' $46M opening weekend performance
- [Weekend Box Office: Hoppers Stays on Top](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/weekend-box-office-hoppers-stays-on-top): Weekend box office report on Hoppers performance and new releases

- [7 Films at NewFest That Celebrate Rural LGBTQ+ Communities](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/7-films-at-newfest-that-celebrate-rural-lgbtq-communities): Feature on LGBTQ+ films at NewFest celebrating rural queer communities
